posts.title: Text Me Once: Notification-Agent Design Rules I Learned from a Nine-Day Spam Storm
posts.description: I run two categories of autonomous agent that are allowed to text my phone. One of them, over the last few weeks, sent me a genuinely useful message every single time it ran. posts.title: The Interface Should Meet You Halfway
posts.description: A placeholder is a promise that disappears at the first sign of intent. The interface shows an example. The person starts typing because the example is close to what they want.
